description: This file defines the PurgeNamespaceResponse class, a final immutable class representing the response to a namespace purge command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to create success/failure responses, to deserialize from JSON, and to access response details such as whether the purge was successful.

classes.name: PurgeNamespaceResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a namespace purge command, including details about success status and JSON (de)serialization.

classes.name: PurgeNamespaceResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions specific to PurgeNamespaceResponse, notably the 'successful' boolean field.

methods.name: successful
methods.description: Returns true if the namespace purge was successful.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PurgeNamespaceResponse instance from a JSON object and headers, deserializing the content.
